Enriched with antioxidant Vitamin C, Vitamin E, Glycerin and Hyaluronic Acid, it helps improve skin radiance, hydrate the skin and reduce the appearance of dark spots, fine lines and uneven skin tone.

Its ultra-light, non-greasy formula features Netlock Technology for an invisible, comfortable finish without a heavy or sticky feel. SPF50+ provides very high UV protection, while the formula is resistant to water and rubbing, making it suitable for everyday use.

SPF50+ very high UVA & UVB protection
Enriched with antioxidant Vitamin C & Vitamin E
Helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and fine lines
Helps improve skin radiance and uneven skin tone

Ultra-lightweight, non-greasy and non-sticky texture
Invisible finish with no white residue
Suitable for all skin types and tones
Can be used around the eye contour
How to Use

Shake well before use. Apply generously every morning as the last step of your skincare routine, before makeup. Reapply regularly, especially after sweating, swimming or prolonged sun exposure.

results.name: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Oil Control Gel-Cream SPF50+

product.title: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Oil Control Gel-Cream SPF50+
product.description: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Oil Control Gel-Cream SPF50+ is a facial sunscreen specifically formulated for combination to oily skin. To begin with, this formula features the exclusive UVMune 400 technology. To explain, this technology features the exclusive Mexoryl 400 filter. Consequently, this makes this sunscreen really effective at protecting against ultra-long UVA rays, considered among the most insidious for the skin. In addition to this innovative filter, this technology combines eight sun filters that allow the skin to be protected against all types of UVA and UVB rays. Equally important, this sunscreen features Airlicium technology. This technology comprises microparticles with a mattifying action to absorb excess sebum and control excess shine. In this way, this sunscreen mattifies the skin for up to 12 hours. Lastly, it also provides antioxidant protection. With a lightweight and non-greasy gel-cream texture, it is weightless upon application for a comfortable feeling. In addition, the formula resists water, sweat, and sand. This dermatologically, and ophthalmologically tested formula is suitable even for sensitive skin and doesn't sting on the eyes. In short, this sunscreen protects the skin from UVB and UVA rays, including ultra-long UVA. At the same time, it controls excess shine with a matte finish and dry touch.

results.name: Sephora Collection Lip Tint Felt Lip Stain & Liner - 05 Espresso Line

product.title: Sephora Collection Lip Tint Felt Lip Stain & Liner - 05 Espresso Line
product.description:
The Sephora Collection Lip Tint Felt Lip Stain & Liner – 05 Espresso Line is a dual-purpose lip product that combines the precision of a lip liner with the lightweight feel and long-lasting power of a lip stain. Featuring an ultra-precise felt-tip applicator, it allows you to easily define, shape, and fill the lips with smooth, even color.

Shade 06 Brownie Sketch is a beautiful muted brownie-berry tone that gives lips a soft natural matte look with buildable intensity. The water-light formula glides effortlessly onto the lips and dries quickly without feeling sticky or heavy, delivering a transfer-proof stain effect that lasts for hours.

Its innovative felt-tip design offers both detailed lining and full lip application, making it perfect for creating defined lip combos or soft blurred lip looks. The lightweight texture feels comfortable on the lips and does not settle heavily into fine lines.

Key Benefits
2-in-1 lip stain & liner
Precise felt-tip applicator
Long-lasting transfer-proof formula
Lightweight comfortable wear
Natural matte finish
Buildable color intensity
Smudge-resistant application
How to Use

Use the tip to outline the lips, then tilt the applicator sideways to fill in the lips evenly. Apply one layer for a soft tint effect or build additional layers for deeper color intensity. Store tip-down for best performance.
